classic_engine.status: runtime mirror preserved; app.js, style.css and version.json unchanged

rules: Graphique and Marché are independent windows
colored Administrator sections are one window each and keep their subsections inside
Missions de vie is one block containing Fonds ERITH.IA, Association, Aerith Enfance, Aerith Animaux and Aerith Terre Vivante
subsections keep their native accordion behavior and receive no global window controls
reduce masks a semantic window without suspending its runtime logic
floating moves the original DOM nodes; no business content is cloned
Window Deck lists semantic workspaces only

window_features: drag when free mode is enabled
Escape restores maximized window or closes Window Deck

suspension_contract.reason: Classic 38.15.11 business runtime is still monolithic; 39.2.1 refuses to fake module suspension.
suspension_contract.current_behavior: minimize/hide only changes presentation; market, WebSocket, timers and analytical runtime keep their existing behavior.
suspension_contract.future: true per-module suspend can be added only when the relevant runtime is explicitly separable and lifecycle-safe.

notes: 39.2 Free Windows V1 is superseded because it treated arbitrary top-level SECTION/DETAILS nodes as windows.
39.2.1 replaces automatic DOM slicing with an explicit semantic map based on the real Administrator hierarchy.
Only nine coherent workspaces receive global window controls.
The original content is moved when detached, never duplicated; docking restores it to its original parent/order.
Classic /web remains the stable public reference; /administrator remains the operator cockpit.
